name: LangChain for LLM Applications
certifications: No official certification; assessed by projects
Optional: cloud AI engineer certifications (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Engineer)
tools: OpenAI, Anthropic or Azure OpenAI models

beginner.summary: For Python developers building their first LLM applications with LangChain. Covers set-up and model providers, chat models and messages, prompt templates, structured output, LCEL runnables, streaming, chat history, document loaders, text splitters, embeddings and vector stores, retrievers, RAG chains, tools, simple agents, LangSmith tracing and evaluation, callbacks, caching and rate limits and serving chains as APIs.
prerequisites: Writes Python functions, classes and virtual environments
Basic idea of what an LLM is
outcomes: Build chains with prompts, models, parsers and LCEL
Build RAG over company documents with loaders, splitters and vector stores
Give models tools and build simple agents
Trace, evaluate and serve LangChain applications

days.topic: LangChain Overview, Packages and Environment Setup
subtopics: What LangChain is and when to use it
Package layout: langchain-core, langchain and partner packages
Model providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI and Google
The course project: an internal knowledge assistant
days.lab_task: Set up a project with LangChain, a hosted model and a local Ollama model, call both with the same code, and view the calls as traces in LangSmith.
checks: Same code works with the local model
Both calls traced with inputs and outputs

subtopics: Model parameters: temperature and max tokens
days.lab_task: Build a helper that answers HR questions with a system message, switch providers with init_chat_model, batch ten questions, run them asynchronously and record token use.
checks: Same answers format from two providers
All ten answered faster than one by one

days.lab_task: Build templates for ticket triage with few-shot examples chosen by similarity, store the prompt in LangSmith and pull it into code.
checks: Similar examples chosen for each ticket

days.lab_task: Extract ticket category, priority and product from text into a Pydantic model, handle invalid output with retries and validate allowed values.
Compose a chain that classifies a ticket, runs two steps in parallel, branches by category and falls back to a second model on errors, then print its graph.
Stream answers token by token to a web page through FastAPI, stream progress events from a multi-step chain and measure time to first token.
checks: Each step's start and end shown

subtopics: Persisting history in Redis or a database
days.lab_task: Add conversation history to the assistant with sessions stored in Redis, trim long histories to a token budget and summarise older messages.
Load HR policies from PDFs, an intranet web page and a CSV of FAQs, add source and department metadata and clean headers and footers.
checks: Source and department on every document

days.lab_task: Split the policies three ways, compare chunk sizes and overlaps, keep headings in metadata and check whether answers to five questions stay inside single chunks.

days.topic: Embeddings and Vector Stores in LangChain
days.lab_task: Embed policy chunks into Chroma and pgvector, search with metadata filters by department, delete an outdated policy and compare results across stores.
Compare similarity, MMR, multi-query and ensemble retrievers on 20 test questions and measure how often the right chunk is in the top five.
checks: Hit rate in the top five for each retriever

days.topic: Building a RAG Chain with Citations
days.lab_task: Build a RAG chain that answers HR questions with source citations, refuses when the documents do not cover the question and handles follow-up questions.
checks: Model says it does not know

days.lab_task: Create tools for leave balance lookup and ticket creation, let the model call them, run the calls and return results, and handle a tool error.
checks: Lookup tool called with the right arguments
Error returned to the model and handled

days.topic: Building a First Agent with LangChain
subtopics: What an agent is in LangChain
When not to use an agent
days.lab_task: Build an HR helpdesk agent with retrieval, leave lookup and ticket tools, limit its steps and stream its progress.
checks: Agent uses two tools in order
Agent stops with a clear message
Cases where a chain is better listed

days.lab_task: Tag traces by feature and user group, find three bad answers from traces, fix their causes and mask personal data before it is traced.
checks: Causes found from traces and fixed

subtopics: Evaluators: exact match, embedding distance and LLM judges
days.lab_task: Create a dataset of 30 HR questions with reference answers, evaluate the RAG chain with correctness and groundedness judges and compare two prompt versions.
checks: Judge agrees with a human on samples

days.lab_task: Write a callback handler that logs latency and tokens to a file, pass user IDs in config for tracing and set timeouts and concurrency limits.
checks: Slow call stopped with an error

days.lab_task: Add a cache for repeated questions, a rate limiter for a provider limit and retries with backoff, and measure cost saved over a test run.
Serve the assistant through FastAPI with streaming, authentication and validation, containerise it and load test it with 20 users.
days.deliverable: API, Dockerfile and load test results

days.lab_task: Build an HR assistant that answers from policy documents with citations, looks up leave balances, raises tickets, remembers the conversation, is evaluated on a dataset and is served as a streaming API, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, evaluation results and demo recording
checks: Ask an uncovered question in the demo
Assistant says it does not know
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one assistant

intermediate.summary: For developers who have built LangChain applications. Covers moving from chains to LangGraph, advanced retrievers, hybrid search and reranking integrations, structured data and SQL, custom tools and toolkits, middleware and guardrails, structured output at scale, multimodal input, document processing pipelines, vector database integrations, advanced evaluation, prompt management, testing, async performance, cost tracking, deployment, security, MCP adapters and LangChain.js.
prerequisites: Builds RAG chains, tools and simple agents with LangChain
outcomes: Build stateful LangGraph applications from LangChain components
Improve retrieval and connect LLMs to data and tools safely
Evaluate, test and tune applications for cost and speed

days.topic: From Chains to Graphs: LangGraph for LangChain Developers
subtopics: Why move from chains to graphs
days.lab_task: Convert the HR assistant into a LangGraph graph with explicit state, a routing node, a checkpointer for memory and streaming, keeping the same LangChain components.
checks: Same answers as the chain version

days.topic: Advanced Retrievers: Parent Documents, Self-Query and Time-Weighted
days.lab_task: Add a parent document retriever, a self-query retriever that turns "policies changed this year in finance" into filters and summaries for long documents, and evaluate each.
Add hybrid search and a reranker to the assistant, tune top-k before and after reranking and measure answer quality and latency.

days.topic: Working with Structured Data: SQL and Tables
days.lab_task: Build a question-answering agent over a read-only HR database with query checking, limit it to safe tables and combine its answers with policy documents.
days.deliverable: SQL agent, permissions and test results

days.lab_task: Build a toolkit for an internal ticketing API with typed arguments, permission checks per user and tests, and give it to the agent.
checks: Call a tool as an unauthorised user
Validation error returned to the model

days.lab_task: Add middleware that redacts personal data, blocks off-topic requests, limits model calls and asks a human to approve ticket creation.
Extract contract fields from 500 contracts in batches, merge results from chunks, send low-confidence cases for review and report accuracy and cost.
checks: Field accuracy against a labelled sample

days.topic: Multimodal Inputs: Images, PDFs and Audio
subtopics: PDFs as images compared with text
days.lab_task: Answer questions about scanned forms and charts with a multimodal model, transcribe a meeting recording and summarise it with action items.

subtopics: Incremental indexing with the indexing API
days.lab_task: Build an ingestion pipeline that parses tables properly, indexes only changed documents with a record manager, removes deleted files and runs nightly.

days.topic: Vector Database Integrations: pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone and Others
days.lab_task: Run the same retrieval on three vector databases, add namespaces per department, tune index settings and migrate data from one store to another.
Add pairwise and agent step evaluators, set up online evaluation for a sample of traffic, review bad cases in an annotation queue and run evaluation in CI.
days.deliverable: Evaluators, online evaluation and CI workflow

subtopics: Prompts as code compared with prompts in a hub
days.lab_task: Store prompts in the hub with development and production tags, test a change in the playground against the dataset and roll back a bad prompt.

subtopics: Unit tests with fake chat models
days.lab_task: Write unit tests with fake models for chains and tools, integration tests for retrieval and a small set of real-model tests marked to run nightly.
checks: Pass without calling a real model

days.lab_task: Profile the assistant with traces, run retrieval and tools in parallel, shrink prompts, switch simple steps to a faster model and hit a latency target.
Track cost per request and feature, route easy questions to a small model, cache common answers, set a budget alert and report savings.

tools: Kubernetes or a cloud app service
days.lab_task: Deploy the assistant to a cloud container service and to LangGraph Platform, with secrets, a Postgres checkpointer and a blue-green release.
checks: App healthy with secrets from a store

days.topic: Security for LLM Applications Built with LangChain
subtopics: Threats: prompt injection, data leaks and tool misuse
days.lab_task: Attack the assistant with injected instructions in a policy document, fix tool permissions and output handling and pass a security checklist.

days.topic: Model Context Protocol Adapters for LangChain
subtopics: Building an MCP server for internal tools
days.lab_task: Build an MCP server for the ticketing API, load its tools into a LangChain agent alongside native tools and secure the connection.

days.topic: LangChain.js for JavaScript and TypeScript Developers
subtopics: Chat models and prompts in TypeScript
days.lab_task: Rebuild a small RAG chat in Next.js with LangChain.js, stream answers to the browser and reuse the same prompt from the hub.
checks: Ask a question in the app

days.lab_task: Build a support copilot as a LangGraph app with hybrid retrieval and reranking, a SQL tool for orders, MCP tools for tickets, guardrails and approval, online evaluation, cost tracking and a blue-green deployment, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, evaluation reports, dashboards and demo recording
checks: Inject a malicious document in the demo
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one copilot

advanced.summary: For senior AI engineers and architects. Covers application architecture at scale, long-running agents, supervisor and swarm designs with LangGraph, long-term memory stores, human-in-the-loop at scale, production evaluation, data flywheels and fine-tuning from traces, latency engineering, multi-tenancy, self-hosted models, enterprise integration, governance and audit, red teaming, custom components, version migrations, framework choices, retrieval at scale, incident response, team practices and a platform capstone.
prerequisites: Builds and deploys LangGraph and LangChain applications
Understands security risks of LLM applications
outcomes: Design scalable, multi-tenant LLM application platforms
Build durable, multi-agent and memory-rich systems
Run evaluation, feedback and fine-tuning loops
Govern, secure and troubleshoot LLM applications

days.topic: Architecture of LLM Applications at Scale
days.lab_task: Design the architecture for an LLM platform serving ten internal apps, decide which services are shared and defend the design in a review.
checks: Fallbacks for model and retrieval outages

days.lab_task: Build an agent that prepares a monthly report over several hours, survives restarts, waits for approval for a day and never repeats a side effect.

days.topic: Supervisor, Swarm and Hierarchical Agents with LangGraph
days.lab_task: Build the same research task with one agent, a supervisor and a swarm, compare quality, cost and latency and decide which to use.
checks: Quality, cost and latency for each

subtopics: Memory types: semantic, episodic and procedural
days.lab_task: Give the assistant long-term memory of user preferences, update and delete memories, keep users isolated and test whether memory improves answers.
checks: Answer quality with and without memory

days.lab_task: Route risky actions to a review queue with a simple UI, let reviewers edit proposed actions, measure reviewer load and feed corrections back into evaluation data.
Monitor quality on sampled traffic with judges and user feedback, detect a quality drop after a model change and roll back.
days.deliverable: Monitoring set-up, alert and rollback record

days.topic: Data Flywheels and Fine-Tuning from Traces
days.lab_task: Build a dataset from good production traces, fine-tune a small model for ticket triage, evaluate it against the large model and route triage to it.
checks: Small model close to the large one

days.lab_task: Cut p95 latency of the support copilot by half using parallel steps, prompt caching, faster models for simple steps and precomputed retrieval.
checks: Lower latency and cost for long prompts

days.lab_task: Make the copilot multi-tenant with isolated retrieval, per-tenant settings, quotas and cost reports, and prove one tenant cannot see another's data.
days.deliverable: Multi-tenant design, tests and cost report

days.topic: Self-Hosted and Open Models with LangChain
days.lab_task: Run the copilot on a self-hosted open model with vLLM, fix tool calling and structured output issues and compare quality and cost with a hosted model.
checks: Tools called correctly by the open model

subtopics: Connecting to CRM, ERP and ITSM systems
days.lab_task: Connect the copilot to a CRM and ITSM system with on-behalf-of access, trigger it from ticket events and keep an audit trail of every action.

days.topic: Governance and Audit for LLM Applications
subtopics: Inventories of apps, prompts and models
days.lab_task: Build an inventory of apps, prompts and models, set change approval and trace retention and prepare a governance review for the copilot.
checks: All apps, prompts and models listed

days.lab_task: Red-team the copilot with automated attacks on prompts, documents and tools, score findings, fix the worst and retest.
days.deliverable: Red team report and retest results

subtopics: Testing with the standard test suites
days.lab_task: Build a custom retriever for an internal search API and a chat model wrapper for an internal gateway, pass the standard tests and package them.
checks: Internal search results returned as Document objects with sources
Gateway model answers inside a chain and calls a tool

subtopics: Moving from legacy chains to LCEL and LangGraph
days.lab_task: Migrate an old LangChain application with legacy agents and memory classes to current APIs, use migration tools and prove behaviour is unchanged with tests.
days.deliverable: Migrated code, test results and upgrade guide

days.topic: Choosing Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel and SDKs
days.lab_task: Build the same RAG feature with LangChain, LlamaIndex and a plain SDK, compare code size, flexibility, observability and performance and write a recommendation.
Scale retrieval to five million chunks with partitions and permission filters, keep it fresh with streaming updates and evaluate quality at scale.
checks: Quality measured on a large sample

subtopics: An incident method for LLM apps
days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected incidents (a provider outage, a retrieval index failure, an agent loop, a cost spike and an injection attempt), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review
checks: Cause found and costs back to normal

days.topic: Team Practices for LLM Application Engineering
subtopics: Standards for prompts, tools and evaluation
days.lab_task: Write team standards and a review checklist for LLM apps, plan shared components and present a 12-month roadmap to a role-play leadership panel.

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise LLM Application Platform
days.lab_task: Design and build a platform for internal LLM apps: shared retrieval with permissions, durable multi-agent workflows, long-term memory, multi-tenancy, evaluation and feedback loops, a fine-tuned routing model, red teaming and governance, then present it to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, platform code, evaluation and red team reports and board presentation
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
